title: What helped my morning sickness in the first trimester
body: I was sick every morning until about week 14. Plain crackers before getting out of bed, ginger tea and small portions of rice and dhal helped me a lot. My PHM also told me to sip water often instead of drinking a lot at once. Hang in there, it does get better!
name: Dilini, Kandy

replies.name: Fathima
replies.body: Ginger tea saved me too. Thank you for sharing!

title: Is it okay to eat ripe papaya in the second trimester?
body: My mother says to avoid all papaya, but my friend says ripe papaya is fine. I am 22 weeks. What did your doctors tell you?
name: Anonymous mother

replies.name: Nimmi
replies.body: My VOG said fully ripe papaya in normal amounts is fine, but to avoid unripe or semi-ripe papaya. Best to ask at your clinic too.

title: Easy first foods my 7-month-old loves
body: We started with rice kanda, then mashed pumpkin and carrot, then dhal mixed with rice. Now she loves mashed banana and a little fish. No salt or sugar yet. Starting slowly with one new food at a time worked for us.
name: Tharuka, Galle
